title: Fix Community Medicine visibility across all app sections

requirements.summary: Ensure Community Medicine is fully defined in frontend subject definitions with all class types properly enumerated
acceptanceCriteria: Community Medicine appears as a selectable subject in the subjects list used throughout the app.
Community Medicine has the same class type options (e.g., Theory, Practical) available as other subjects.
The subject definition in subjects.ts includes Community Medicine with proper category mappings (Theory/Practical thresholds).

file_operations.description: Add Community Medicine to the SUBJECTS array with complete type definitions (Theory, Practical, SDL, AETCOM) matching the structure of Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry. Ensure the typeToCategory mapping includes Community Medicine types so attendance calculations work correctly.

requirements.summary: Add Community Medicine SubjectStatsCard to Dashboard to display attendance statistics
acceptanceCriteria: A SubjectStatsCard for Community Medicine is rendered on the Dashboard.
The card shows correct attended/conducted counts and attendance percentage for Community Medicine.
The card reflects the same threshold rules (75% Theory, 80% Practical) as other subjects.

file_operations.description: Add a SubjectStatsCard component for Community Medicine alongside the existing cards for Anatomy, Physiology, and Biochemistry. Pass 'Community Medicine' as the subject prop so the card filters and displays attendance statistics correctly.

requirements.summary: Fix Today's Schedule and Add Class page to support Community Medicine timetable entries and manual class logging
acceptanceCriteria: Community Medicine timetable entries scheduled for today appear in TodaySchedule with Present/Absent action buttons.
Community Medicine is listed as a selectable subject in the Add Class form.
Marking attendance for a Community Medicine class log correctly updates attendance statistics.

file_operations.description: Verify that TodaySchedule correctly reads and displays timetable entries with subject 'Community Medicine'. The component already filters by today's day and matches timetable entries with class logs, so ensure no hardcoded subject filters exclude Community Medicine.

Verify that the subject dropdown in the Add Class form includes Community Medicine from the SUBJECTS array. Ensure the dynamic type options (based on selected subject) include all Community Medicine types when Community Medicine is selected.

requirements.summary: Ensure Community Medicine is available in Records page filter and Analytics page statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Community Medicine appears in the subject filter dropdown on the Records page.
Records logged under Community Medicine are retrievable by filtering for that subject.
Analytics page shows Community Medicine in the per-subject attendance breakdown chart.

file_operations.description: Verify that the subject filter dropdown includes Community Medicine from the SUBJECTS array. Ensure the filtering logic correctly matches class logs with subject 'Community Medicine' when that filter is applied.

Verify that the subject-wise statistics calculation and chart rendering include Community Medicine. Ensure the per-subject attendance breakdown iterates over all subjects including Community Medicine and displays its theory/practical/AETCOM percentages.

requirements.summary: Audit and update storage models to include Community Medicine in subject type unions
acceptanceCriteria: The Subject type union in models.ts includes 'Community Medicine'.
TimetableEntry and ClassLog records with subject 'Community Medicine' can be stored and retrieved without type errors.
No TypeScript type errors arise from using Community Medicine as a subject value.

file_operations.description: Add 'Community Medicine' to the Subject type union if missing. Verify that ClassLog and TimetableEntry interfaces use this Subject type so that Community Medicine is a valid literal value for storing and retrieving records.
